# Exact mean of eight integers

## Task

Return the arithmetic mean of the eight values of `a`, rounded toward zero. The exact sum of the values may not fit in 64 bits; the result must still be exact.

## Signature

    mean8(a: [8]i64) -> i64

## Examples

    mean8([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]) == 4
    mean8([-1, -2, -3, -4, -5, -6, -7, -8]) == -4
    mean8([10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10]) == 10

## Hidden tests

    mean8([9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807]) == 9223372036854775807
    mean8([-9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808]) == -9223372036854775808
    mean8([9223372036854775807, -9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807, -9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807, -9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807, -9223372036854775808]) == 0
    mean8([9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 0]) == 8070450532247928831
    mean8([-9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775808, 0]) == -8070450532247928832
    mean8([1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0]) == 0
    mean8([-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 0]) == 0
    mean8([9, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]) == 1
    mean8([-9, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]) == -1
    mean8([9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]) == 2305843009213693952
